name: Richard F. Kaumo
occupation: Lieutenant in the Sweetwater County Sheriff's Office, overseeing detention-center operations; sheriff-elect taking office in January 2027 (campaign website and Green River Star, Aug. 6, 2026)
education: His campaign website says he has more than 3,500 hours of Wyoming POST training and is pursuing a Master of Science degree with an emphasis in strategic leadership (institution not named on that page)
background: Richard F. Kaumo is the Sweetwater County sheriff-elect and takes office in January 2027. On his campaign website and in a Green River Star voter-guide statement he wrote that he was born and raised in Rock Springs, has nearly two decades in law enforcement, served with the Sublette County and Sweetwater County sheriff's offices in detention, patrol, investigations, and specialized assignments, and has overseen the Sweetwater County Detention Center, including about 50 employees and court security, and serves as the office's search and rescue team leader. Appointed Sheriff Rich Fischer, who lost the Republican primary, serves through the current term.
